name: forex-calendar
title: Forex Calendar
description: Economic calendar from ForexFactory's public weekly feed: today, tomorrow, upcoming and this week, filtered by impact and currency.
author: black

commands.name: calendar
commands.title: Economic Calendar
commands.description: Today, tomorrow, upcoming and this week's economic events with impact, forecast and previous, filtered by impact and currency.

preferences.name: minImpact
preferences.title: Minimum Impact
preferences.description: Hide events below this impact. Holidays count as the lowest level and show only under Everything.

preferences.name: currencies
preferences.title: Currencies
preferences.description: Currency codes to keep, comma-separated, e.g. USD,EUR,GBP. Events for every market always show. Empty keeps all currencies.
